title: Describe your home

prepTasks.word: The apartment is on the... floor.

writingModel: I want to describe the apartment where I live in Uralsk. I rent this apartment with my friend Zara — it is close to WKU university and it is perfect for two students. The apartment is on the third floor of a quiet residential building. It is small but very comfortable, and I feel completely at home here.

There is a small hallway when you enter the apartment. In the hallway, there is a large mirror and there are two coat hooks on the wall. The hallway leads to three main areas: the living room, the kitchen, and the bedroom. There is also one bathroom at the end of the corridor. There isn't a separate study room, but there are desks in the bedroom for both of us.

The living room is my favourite room in the apartment. There is a comfortable blue sofa in the centre, and there is a flat-screen television on the wall. There are two large bookshelves near the window — one for my Economics textbooks and one for Zara's novels. There is a big window with white curtains that lets in a lot of natural light in the mornings. There isn't a dining table in the living room, but there is a small coffee table in front of the sofa.

The kitchen is small but very practical. There is a round table in the centre with four chairs around it. There is a fridge in the corner, a microwave above the counter, and a small electric kettle for tea. There is also a washing machine under the counter — very useful for students! There isn't a dishwasher, but that is the only thing missing. The kitchen is where Zara and I have breakfast and dinner together every day.

My favourite feature of the whole apartment is the balcony. There is a small balcony off the living room with a beautiful view of the courtyard and the trees below. There are four potted plants on the balcony — Zara takes care of all of them. In the evenings, we sometimes sit on the balcony and drink tea. There is a small park just around the corner from our building too. I love our apartment — it is simple, affordable, and it truly feels like home!
